noncomputable def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type u_9} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type u_10) [DecidablePred p] : ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := by
  have h_forward : ∀ (f : (i : α) → β i), ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := by
    intro f
    refine' ⟨fun i => f i.val, fun i => f i.val⟩
  
  have h_inverse : ∀ ((f₁ : (i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × (f₂ : (i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i)), (i : α) → β i := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : (i : α) → β i := by
      intro i
      by_cases h₂ : p i
      · -- Case: p i is true
        have h₃ : (⟨i, h₂⟩ : {x // p x}) = ⟨i, h₂⟩ := rfl
        have h₄ : f₁ ⟨i, h₂⟩ = f₁ ⟨i, h₂⟩ := rfl
        exact f₁ ⟨i, h₂⟩
      · -- Case: p i is false
        have h₃ : (⟨i, by simpa using h₂⟩ : {x // ¬p x}) = ⟨i, by simpa using h₂⟩ := rfl
        have h₄ : f₂ ⟨i, by simpa using h₂⟩ = f₂ ⟨i, by simpa using h₂⟩ := rfl
        exact f₂ ⟨i, by simpa using h₂⟩
    exact h₁
  
  have h_main : ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := by
    apply Equiv.ofHomEq (fun f => h_forward f)
    ext f
    have h₁ : (f : (i : α) → β i) = f := rfl
    have h₂ : (h_inverse (h_forward f) : (i : α) → β i) = f := by
      funext i
      by_cases h₃ : p i
      · -- Case: p i is true
        have h₄ : f i = f i := rfl
        have h₅ : (h_inverse (h_forward f) i : β i) = f i := by
          simp [h_forward, h₃]
          <;> simp_all [Subtype.mk.injEq]
          <;> aesop
        exact h₅
      · -- Case: p i is false
        have h₄ : f i = f i := rfl
        have h₅ : (h_inverse (h_forward f) i : β i) = f i := by
          simp [h_forward, h₃]
          <;> simp_all [Subtype.mk.injEq]
          <;> aesop
        exact h₅
    simp_all [Equiv.ext_iff]
    <;> aesop
  
  exact h_main
